# Creator Hustle AI

> Creator Hustle AI (formerly Course Hustle) is Liya Bergen's business teaching coaches and creators to use AI to make, sell and automate simple digital products: mini apps, Claude Skills, mini courses and AI clones. Liya has built online courses and digital products since 2014. Everything is designed for busy, non-techy business owners who want to get visible and sell more without long product launches.

Contact: liya@creatorhustle.ai · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/creatorhustle.ai/ · Shop: https://creatorhustle.shop · Course library (students): https://learn.creatorhustle.ai

## Free resources

- [PDF to Interactive Workbook Claude Skill](https://creatorhustle.ai/pdf-to-interactive-workbook): free Claude skill that turns PDF workbooks, worksheets and planners into interactive workbooks clients complete on screen.
- [Mini App Idea Finder](https://creatorhustle.ai/mini-app-idea-finder): answer a few questions and get a ready-to-build plan for a first mini app.

## Courses and products

- [Interactive Mini Apps](https://creatorhustle.ai/interactive-mini-app): course that shows how to turn a PDF freebie into an interactive mini app, in 4 short lessons with no code ($49).
- [Mini Courses with AI Clone](https://creatorhustle.ai/mini-courses-with-ai-clone): a 5-step system to plan, build, present and publish a mini course with an AI clone presenter, so you never need to be on camera ($39).
- [Skills Shop](https://creatorhustle.ai/skills-shop): ready-made Claude Skills that walk you step by step through building real systems in your business.
- [AI Support Ticket Hub](https://creatorhustle.ai/ai-support-ticket-hub): Claude Skill for building an AI support ticket hub with drafted replies, phone alerts and one-click answers.
- [AI Collab Request Hub](https://creatorhustle.ai/ai-collab-request-hub): Claude Skill for building a collab request hub with AI-drafted replies that check fit.
- [Pinterest Pin Studio](https://creatorhustle.ai/pinterest-pin-studio): Claude Skill ($49) that turns your own Canva pin templates and mockups into fresh Pinterest pins, with a Google Sheet pin database, Notion approval board and scheduling.
- [Build Your Own Website with AI](https://creatorhustle.ai/build-your-own-website-with-ai): Claude Skill that guides you through building a business website and publishing it free on your own domain.
- [All Access Pass](https://creatorhustle.ai/all-access-pass): every Creator Hustle AI course and shop product, plus everything new for 12 months, for one yearly price.
- [Creator Hustle shop](https://creatorhustle.shop): low-cost AI tools, Claude Skills, Canva prompt libraries and done-for-you kits.

- [Build Your Website with AI](https://creatorhustle.ai/build-your-website-with-ai): your website built together with AI inside your own accounts.
